observations.label: Description
observations.text:
1) Speak to Master Tallon Darkfist in Tanvu. You must collect a few manifestations.
2) Turn so the water if on your left and the land is on your right, and start running along the coast. You will almost immediately run into the second manifestation, Liquid Essence of Jin, that wanders along the coastline. (-4478, -73853, +227)
3) Keep running in the same direction and you will run into a gazebo like structure. In the middle of the gazebo is the first manifestation. (-8876, -76338, +1449).
4) Head directly north-northeast and about 2/3 of the way up the hill in a very small building, you'll find the fourth manifestation. (-935, -91864, +1861).
5) Head west-northwest and over the far side you will find a circular group of pylons. In the middle of there is the third manifestation. (-25671, -86395, +2489)
6) Return to Master Tallon Darkfist in Tanvu for your reward.

observations.text:
Master Tallon Darkfist roams near the beach.
You have to hail the essence to advance the quest. This does not need to be in exact order.
Flowing Essence of Jin -8715, -76174, 1450 in Tanvu (-19, 6) - in a Gazebo.
Liquid Essence of Jin -1844, -78464, 176 in Tanvu (-19, 6) - on the beach.
Forest Essence of Jin -26678, -87056, 2429 in Tanvu (-19, 6) - in a circle of standing stones.
Fiery Essences of Jin -806, -92205, 1868 in Tanvu (-19, 6) - in a little shrine.

findings.observation: Primary objective says Charge the Jin Crystal; the separately labelled fandom account records Charged Crystal of Jin (1) and prose defining positive Lao’Jin and negative Ra’Jin. Preserve the accounts separately; neither establishes a verified branching mechanic.

Description directs speaking to Master Tallon Darkfist then Disciple Hirro to decide how to enchant the crystal. Notes place Hirro near the gazebo and Flowing Essense of Jin. This remains directional prose, not canonical spawn coordinates. Details name Master Tallon Darkfist as hand-in NPC while the page reports an ends npc disagreement; retain the full archive records and conflicting claims without choosing a turn-in.

Displayed Coin reward is 6 without denomination; copper remains unknown. Page reports level disagreements for fandom and wiki.silkyvenom.com:80; displayed level is not resolution of historical variants.

A Jin Divided links Previous to Manifestations Of Jin. Their respective charge-crystal and absorb-manifestations objectives remain page-specific observations; no objective merge, enforced prerequisite or independent corroboration is established by the archive links or mirrored source attribution.
